head: YouTube TV 'Video unavailable' error interrupts shows and live sports
dek: YouTube TV viewers report a black 'Video unavailable' screen that cuts into shows and games for about 10 seconds, sometimes several times in one broadcast. Google hasn't commented yet.
details: Some viewers say it only happens on NBC channels, which isn't confirmed. Android Authority asked Google and NBC for comment. It comes after a separate bug that removed channels from the Live tab, which Google fixed.
where: YouTube TV, reported by viewers in the US
means: If your show or game suddenly goes black with 'Video unavailable', it's a known problem other viewers have too, not your TV or internet.
todo: There's no known fix yet. Playback comes back after about 10 seconds on its own.
